programmes.d: A pair of newlyweds stopping in a small town are trapped by their own superstition when playing a fortune telling machine in a local diner.
A scientist creates an android that has the qualities which he feels he's lacking.
A man named Benteen leads a colony of Americans stranded on a desert planet for 30 years.
In a tragic, western town, a desperate father begs for clemency as his son is slated to die for an accident he could not have prevented.
Millicent Barnes sees her double at a bus terminal.

A luckless couple stumbles upon fortune when a genie materializes from a bottle in their antique shop. The genie grants them four wishes but warns them, prophetically, to be careful what you wish for.
A three-man spacecraft lands on a planet only to discover the wreckage of a spacecraft identical to their own.
Oliver Crangle is a bitter, prejudiced man. Through unknown means, he intends to shrink every evil person in the world at four o'clock.
A street salesman cleverly eludes Death. But if he lives, a little girl must die in his place.

After successfully stealing a gold shipment, a group of criminals and their scientist accomplice put themselves in suspended animation in a remote desert cave. When they awaken decades later, complications ensue when their truck is destroyed.

Actor Rance McGrew makes TV Westerns for a living, but he's a lousy actor and a worse cowboy. Despite that, each week he "wins" against the bad guys. Finally, the bad guys have had enough and decide to teach McGrew a lesson.

Martin Sloan, driving through the country, leaves his car and starts to walk toward his hometown, Homewood. He finds things exactly as they were when he was a child. He soon realizes he's gone back in time.
Tight fisted Franklin Gibbs is not pleased when his wife wins a trip for two to Las Vegas. But things change when he falls under the spell of a slot machine that calls his name.
When three dum-dum crooks get ahold of a camera that takes pictures of the future, they set out to make a quick fortune with their new toy.
On the road home from the Civil War, a Confederate soldier stops at a burned-out house and gets to know the owner, a recent widow.
Lt. Fitzgerald has found his own special wartime hell. Looking into the faces of his men prior to battle, he has the disquieting ability to see who is about to die.
A plane lands safely, but the pilot, crew and all of its passengers are missing!
While in the hospital recovering from overwork, Liz Powell keeps dreaming about going down to the hospital morgue.
Small time criminal Jackie Rhoades must face both his past and his conscience while waiting for his next assignment.
A has-been, drunk gunslinger finds his fast-draw abilities magically restored.
A loud-mouthed braggart's boasts attract the attention of some aliens.
When a space exploration crashes on Mars, the surviving passenger is surprised to find that Martians are human-looking, very friendly and apparently just like us...
A man who can change his face to resemble others gets into hot water with gangsters.
A scientist arranges to have his human-looking robot pitch for the struggling local baseball team.
A widower buys a robot grandmother for his three children.
A singer's song becomes tragically real.
Riding home on the train one day, a man falls asleep and dreams it is 1880, and he is entering a small town called Willoughby.
A man finds that he can trade anything he has, including youth and personality, with anybody else.
The senior residents of Sunnyvale decide that the secret to youth is acting young, and in particular playing a childhood game called "kick-the-can."
The daughter of an inventor objects to their 'perfect' home where they are waited on by mechanical servants.
The lone survivors of two annihilated worlds are stranded on a distant planet.
